gaps.description: Open. Source-complete inventories, governing-relation annotation, semantic matching, and segmentation-specific preservation measurements remain untested for msgloom.
gaps.resolution_notes: If later authorized, independently inventory source-grounded conditions, exceptions, deadlines, evidence requirements, approval constraints, and decision qualifiers with their governing attachments. Audit inventory completeness separately from downstream matching. Report omitted items/all adjudicated eligible source items by category, broadened or misattached relations/all eligible governing relations, unsupported assertions/all emitted assertions, and fully preserved evidence objects/all eligible evidence objects. Include intact-fact but incorrect-attachment controls and partially recovered propositions. Evaluate automatic loss detection using critical-loss recall and alert precision against adjudicated cases. Exclude B01 FactCC values, B02 extractiveness Coverage, and C01 argument/error-sample percentages from inferred Topic-preservation rates. Topic 04 retains semantic response/agreement interpretation.
